problem_type: Renderer mode and variant identity lose compatibility at the shared owner boundary
symptom: The main Jimeng mode switch keeps v3_0 in edit instead of the declared 5.0 Pro; four compatibility cases fail for Flash mode persistence, supported variant clamping and aliases.
direct_cause: Variant resolution receives the unfiltered profile and mode switching selects using the old mode; canonical-only identity checks and early returns skip legacy/canonical mode persistence.
class_root: Canonical profile/mode identity and mode-compatible candidates must be established before delegating the one variant priority decision; UI selection, normalized meta and wire projection must refer to that result.
affected_population: Existing canonical and legacy node meta
Mode/variant switching, auto-normalization, controls, spend confirmation and parameter projection
internal_only_reason: This is repository-authored domain glue. Existing shared resolver, profile declarations, frontend callers and pure host admission/contract code determine the invariant; no third-party or provider behavior is assumed.
invariants: Only archetypeMeta production code changes; no shared/admission/profile/default/price/gate/baseline changes
Existing shared resolveArchetypeVariant owns all choice priorities; renderer only filters its candidates with existing supportedModeIds semantics
Compatible explicit choices including aliases/legacy profile IDs win over conflicting model names; no implicit host upgrade
Switch target mode before variant resolution, specialize/clamp from that legal result, and write canonical IDs explicitly
Preserve uploaded/edge reference storage, order, custom meta and input immutability; normalization remains idempotent

door_reduction.why_not: These existing renderer/UI/runner readers and user actions remain separate. They already converge in archetypeMeta; the fix repairs that common interpretation rather than remove legitimate controls, reference attachment paths or spending confirmation inputs.

generality_proof: Retain all reported tests and execute real renderer functions, shared resolution and pure host admission/contract code across legal/illegal old variants, aliases, legacy IDs, canonical mode migration, control narrowing, raw references and user meta. Shared resolver/profile inputs remain unchanged and compatible inexpensive choices remain authoritative.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve the current canonical mode and project compatible candidates into the existing shared owner
Resolve in the target mode, persist the explicit legal variant and clamp only declared select controls
Persist canonical legacy identity/mode/variant before idempotent/no-variant early exits

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both switch callbacks and displayed selection already delegate to the changed archetypeMeta boundary
Keep existing catalog-row migration guard and merge returned patch; shared canonical/legacy identity is interpreted consistently
Host uses the unchanged shared resolver and declared variant list, not a new mode fallback; explicit compatible low-cost choices remain unchanged

recurrence.reason: Any profile with supportedModeIds or legacy identities can reproduce old-mode resolution, premature idempotency and frontend/wire drift.
same_class_scan: Generated all 24 existing renderer caller doors
Read renderer mode/variant controls, normalization guard, spend confirmation and parameter projection
Read shared variantResolution and real Jimeng/Flash definitions without editing them
Read host compile options, admission, module registry and profile request construction; no transport invoked

prevention.invariant: Canonical mode-compatible candidates are interpreted consistently at the renderer bridge before the single shared resolver decides.
prevention.failure_mode: Target-mode illegal variants cannot remain selected or leak into the wire model; no legal candidate does not invent a model, and existing host explicit identity is never silently upgraded.
prevention.strategy: Repair the existing identity and filtering bridge and remove old-mode preservation; no parallel resolver, provider branch or gate exemption.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unfiltered/old-mode choice and premature legacy-mode early exits in place; no alternate legacy resolver remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency/API upgrade. Existing shared Nomi domain resolver and declared profiles already own the choice rules.

migration: Existing ensure/normalize canonicalize node metadata lazily through their existing callers; no persisted project file is edited in this task.
residual_risks: No full suite, real App, Provider, paid task, screenshot or production typecheck is run; coordination owns final integration
Host variant admission remains profile-wide rather than adding mode-specific rejection; this task does not silently transform external explicit unsupported requests into expensive defaults
